# Precision Guesswork Technologies (PGT)

> A small studio based in Flint, Michigan that builds small businesses a website with an honest AI assistant. The assistant answers customer questions from the business's real information, takes booking, order and quote requests, and says plainly when it doesn't know. PGT also makes Tinker, a time clock for crews that clocks in from a phone or tablet with a location tag on each punch.

- Location: Flint, Michigan. Serves Genesee County and the rest of Michigan, mostly by text and email.
- Owner: Les Fleming. Contact: lesfleming@precisionguessworktech.com
- Who it's for: salons, barbershops, restaurants, diners, food trucks, auto repair shops, detailers, lawn care, snow removal, cleaning and handyman businesses.
